title: ERCOT HB_BUSAVG: real-time prices by time of day
subtitle: Quartiles of 15-minute prices by block, 2026-09-04 to 2026-10-03, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, SPP via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table iso_rtm_hub_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-04.
citations: California Independent System Operator (CAISO). PRC_INTVL_LMP: OASIS Interval Locational Marginal Prices, real-time dispatch (RTD, 5-minute). https://oasis.caiso.com/mrioasis/logon.do. Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). NP6-785-ER: Historical RTM Load Zone and Hub Prices. https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP6-785-ER. Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). NP6-905-CD: Settlement Point Prices at Resource Nodes, Hubs and Load Zones. https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP6-905-CD. Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO). rt_lmp_final: Real-Time Final Market LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]. https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/real-time--market-data/market-reports/. Midcontinent Independent System Operator (MISO). rt_lmp_prelim: Real-Time Preliminary Ex-Post LMP, hourly (daily csv) [PAUSED 2026-10-04: MISO's terms forbid automated access; pulls paused pending a review of MISO's terms by a person (docs/methods/miso_pause.md)]. https://www.misoenergy.org/markets-and-operations/real-time--market-data/market-reports/. Southwest Power Pool (SPP). RTBM-LMP-SL: RTBM LMP by Settlement Location, 5-minute. https://portal.spp.org/pages/rtbm-lmp-by-location. Retrieved 2026-10-04 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table iso_rtm_hub_prices, data commit 9c8cc9445771. Provenance tier: source (as the publisher published it, reshaped only).
facts: ERCOT HB_BUSAVG real-time prices, 2026-09-04 to 2026-10-03 (30 days): median overnight 31.23, midday 31.81, peak 47.83 USD/MWh.
Peak minus midday median, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03: 11.45 USD/MWh.
